CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telegram_users (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  telegram_user_id bigint NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  chat_id bigint NOT NULL,
  username text,
  first_name text,
  last_name text,
  active_agent_id bigint,
  dialog_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS elevenlabs_agents (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id bigint NOT NULL REFERENCES telegram_users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  elevenlabs_agent_id text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  display_name text NOT NULL,
  knowledge_document_id text,
  prompt_text text,
  welcome_text text,
  status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bot_events (
  id bigserial PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id bigint REFERENCES telegram_users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  agent_id bigint REFERENCES elevenlabs_agents(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  event_type text NOT NULL,
  status text NOT NULL,
  error_message text,
  metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bot_settings (
  id smallint PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 1,
  bot_access_password text NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  telegram_bot_api_base_url text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'https://api.telegram.org/botreplace-with-telegram-bot-token',
  max_agents_per_user integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 3 CHECK (max_agents_per_user > 0),
  default_agent_prompt text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'You are a helpful voice assistant.',
  default_agent_welcome text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hello, how can I help you today?',
  default_agent_language text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en',
  default_agent_voice_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cjVigY5qzO86Huf0OWal',
  default_agent_tts_model_id text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'eleven_turbo_v2',
  default_agent_llm text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'gpt-4o-mini',
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT bot_settings_singleton CHECK (id = 1)
);

INSERT INTO bot_settings (id)
VALUES (1)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_telegram_users_telegram_user_id
  ON telegram_users(telegram_user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_elevenlabs_agents_user_id
  ON elevenlabs_agents(user_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_elevenlabs_agents_elevenlabs_agent_id
  ON elevenlabs_agents(elevenlabs_agent_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bot_events_user_created_at
  ON bot_events(user_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_bot_events_agent_created_at
  ON bot_events(agent_id, created_at DESC);

SELECT true AS schema_ready;

SELECT
  (bot_access_password <> '') AS access_password_configured,
  (bot_access_password <> '' AND bot_access_password = $1) AS access_password_matched,
  telegram_bot_api_base_url,
  max_agents_per_user,
  default_agent_prompt,
  default_agent_welcome,
  default_agent_language,
  default_agent_voice_id,
  default_agent_tts_model_id,
  default_agent_llm
FROM bot_settings
WHERE id = 1;

WITH bot_user AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM telegram_users
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
),
agent_rows AS (
  SELECT
    a.id,
    a.elevenlabs_agent_id,
    a.display_name,
    a.knowledge_document_id,
    a.prompt_text,
    a.welcome_text,
    a.status,
    a.created_at,
    (a.id = (SELECT active_agent_id FROM bot_user)) AS is_active
  FROM elevenlabs_agents a
  WHERE a.user_id = (SELECT id FROM bot_user)
    AND a.status = 'active'
  ORDER BY a.created_at ASC
),
active_agent AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM agent_rows
  WHERE is_active
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(to_jsonb((SELECT row_to_json(bot_user) FROM bot_user)), 'null'::jsonb) AS user_record,
  COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agent_rows)) FROM agent_rows), '[]'::jsonb) AS agents,
  COALESCE(to_jsonb((SELECT row_to_json(active_agent) FROM active_agent)), 'null'::jsonb) AS active_agent;

INSERT INTO telegram_users (
  telegram_user_id,
  chat_id,
  username,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  dialog_state
)
VALUES (
  $1,
  $2,
  NULLIF($3, ''),
  NULLIF($4, ''),
  NULLIF($5, ''),
  'idle'
)
ON CONFLICT (telegram_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
  chat_id = EXCLUDED.chat_id,
  username = EXCLUDED.username,
  first_name = EXCLUDED.first_name,
  last_name = EXCLUDED.last_name,
  dialog_state = 'idle',
  updated_at = now()
RETURNING
  id,
  telegram_user_id,
  chat_id,
  username,
  first_name,
  last_name,
  active_agent_id,
  dialog_state,
  created_at,
  updated_at,
  telegram_user_id AS "telegramUserId";

UPDATE telegram_users
SET
  dialog_state = COALESCE(NULLIF($2, ''), dialog_state),
  active_agent_id = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, '')::bigint, active_agent_id),
  updated_at = now()
WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
RETURNING *;

WITH updated_agent AS (
  UPDATE elevenlabs_agents
  SET
    elevenlabs_agent_id = $2,
    status = 'active',
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $1::bigint
    AND user_id = (
      SELECT id
      FROM telegram_users
      WHERE telegram_user_id = $3
    )
    AND status = 'creating'
  RETURNING *
),
updated_user AS (
  UPDATE telegram_users
  SET
    active_agent_id = (SELECT id FROM updated_agent),
    dialog_state = 'idle',
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $3
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_agent)
  RETURNING telegram_user_id
)
SELECT
  updated_agent.*,
  (SELECT telegram_user_id FROM updated_user) AS "telegramUserId"
FROM updated_agent;

WITH bot_user AS (
  SELECT id, telegram_user_id
  FROM telegram_users
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
  FOR UPDATE
),
agent_count AS (
  SELECT count(*)::int AS reserved_count
  FROM elevenlabs_agents
  WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM bot_user)
    AND (
      status = 'active'
      OR (status = 'creating' AND updated_at > now() - interval '15 minutes')
    )
),
reserved_agent AS (
  INSERT INTO elevenlabs_agents (
    user_id,
    elevenlabs_agent_id,
    display_name,
    prompt_text,
    welcome_text,
    status
  )
  SELECT
    bot_user.id,
    $2,
    $3,
    $4,
    $5,
    'creating'
  FROM bot_user, agent_count
  WHERE agent_count.reserved_count < $6::int
  RETURNING *
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(reserved_agent) FROM reserved_agent), 'null'::jsonb) AS reserved_agent,
  (SELECT telegram_user_id FROM bot_user) AS "telegramUserId",
  (SELECT reserved_count FROM agent_count) AS reserved_count,
  $6::int AS max_agents;

WITH bot_user AS (
  SELECT id, telegram_user_id
  FROM telegram_users
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
),
updated_agent AS (
  UPDATE elevenlabs_agents
  SET
    prompt_text = CASE WHEN $4 = 'prompt' THEN $3 ELSE prompt_text END,
    welcome_text = CASE WHEN $4 = 'welcome' THEN $3 ELSE welcome_text END,
    knowledge_document_id = CASE WHEN $4 = 'knowledge' THEN NULLIF($5, '') ELSE knowledge_document_id END,
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = $2::bigint
    AND user_id = (SELECT id FROM bot_user)
    AND status = 'active'
  RETURNING *
),
updated_user AS (
  UPDATE telegram_users
  SET
    dialog_state = 'idle',
    updated_at = now()
  WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM bot_user)
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM updated_agent)
  RETURNING telegram_user_id
)
SELECT
  updated_agent.*,
  (SELECT telegram_user_id FROM updated_user) AS "telegramUserId"
FROM updated_agent;

WITH bot_user AS (
  SELECT id, telegram_user_id
  FROM telegram_users
  WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
),
locked_agent AS (
  SELECT a.*
  FROM elevenlabs_agents a
  WHERE a.id = $2::bigint
    AND a.user_id = (SELECT id FROM bot_user)
    AND a.status = 'active'
  FOR UPDATE
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(locked_agent) FROM locked_agent), 'null'::jsonb) AS validated_agent,
  (SELECT telegram_user_id FROM bot_user) AS "telegramUserId";

INSERT INTO bot_events (
  user_id,
  agent_id,
  event_type,
  status,
  error_message,
  metadata
)
VALUES (
  NULLIF($1, '')::bigint,
  NULLIF($2, '')::bigint,
  $3,
  $4,
  NULLIF($5, ''),
  $6::jsonb
)
RETURNING id;

UPDATE telegram_users
SET
  dialog_state = 'idle',
  updated_at = now()
WHERE telegram_user_id = $1
RETURNING telegram_user_id;
